_comment: VALIDATION sweep — same parameter distribution as gen.json (identical context_param_specs / ic_param_specs / colliders / solver settings), but a DIFFERENT seed so both the meshes and the sampled systems are unseen. n_meshes=9 gives 9 distinct collider geometries, i.e. 9 self-contained validation datasets (one mesh dir each). n_context/n_ic are smaller than training only to keep the validation set modest — they are sample COUNTS, not the distribution, so 'same distribution' is preserved. Generate with -o so it lands in data/fvm_validation:  python fvm_model/fvm_gen/run_gen.py fvm_model/fvm_gen/val.json -o ../data/fvm_validation
